# Welcome to Jetic 🚀

Jetic is building the next generation of API testing and simulation. By combining AI agents, workflow memory, behavioral graphs, and autonomous execution, Jetic helps developers understand, test, and verify how applications actually behave—not just how individual endpoints respond.

We believe modern software should be tested as complete workflows, not isolated API requests.

### The Community

To get involved with our community, join our discussions, contribute to open-source projects, share ideas, and help shape the future of API behavior intelligence. Follow us on social platforms for product updates, technical deep dives, and community announcements.

### Product Roadmap

We're building an open ecosystem for autonomous API verification. Follow our roadmap, track issues, suggest new features, and contribute to the projects that power Jetic.

### Documentation & Tutorials

Visit our documentation, explore examples, and learn how to build behavior-aware API testing workflows, custom plugins, and simulation agents with Jetic.

# Contribute to Jetic Projects

We value contributions from developers, QA engineers, security researchers, platform teams, and open-source enthusiasts. Whether it's documentation, code, plugins, testing, or ideas, every contribution helps improve the Jetic ecosystem.

**[Contribute to Jetic →](https://github.com/jetic)**

By contributing to Jetic, you're helping build the future of autonomous API behavior testing and workflow simulation.

| Open Source Projects | Description                                                                               |
| :------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Jetic CLI            | AI-native CLI for API behavior testing, workflow simulation, and autonomous verification. |
| Jetic Core           | Behavioral graph engine, workflow memory system, and execution runtime.                   |
| Jetic Plugins        | Extensible plugin ecosystem for security, frameworks, data generation, and integrations.  |
| Jetic SDK            | Build custom agents, workflows, simulations, and platform integrations.                   |
| Jetic Visualizer     | Interactive workflow and behavior graph visualization platform.                           |
